_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.vi: Dịch nguyên văn "What is your good name?" (shubh naam)
mistake.l1: A literal translation of the polite Hindi “shubh naam”.

segments.text: Don't say, what is your good name? Say, what is your name?
Good name sounds strange to many English speakers.
To be extra polite, say, may I have your name, please?
Repeat after me. May I have your name, please?

native.caption: भारत में “What is your good name?” आम है, पर ज़्यादातर अंग्रेज़ी बोलने वालों को यह अजीब लगता है। बस कहिए “What is your name?” ({m:name})। और भी विनम्र: “May I have your name, please?” Carlos टीचर के बाद दोहराइए और Lexkite ऐप में अभ्यास कीजिए।

en.caption: In India “What is your good name?” is common, but most English speakers find it strange. Just say “What is your name?” ({m:name}). Even more polite: “May I have your name, please?” Repeat after teacher Carlos and practice in the Lexkite app.
